requirements.text: Use authentic Sleepyhead logo artwork and appropriate supplied variant; preserve its proportions, colours, contrast and clear space. Do not rotate, distort, recolour, bevel, emboss or add a drop shadow. No production logo artwork is present in the supplied materials.

The excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042. The white specification conflicts: RGB indicates #FFFFFF, while the printed hex is #231F20. Treat white as unresolved; do not use #231F20 as white.
The excerpts name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. Font availability and licensing are unconfirmed; do not claim exact rendering unless verified.
Keep selected colours, patterns and mixed design elements cohesive; the excerpts call for bold colour, playful patterns and asymmetry.

preferences.text: Supplied excerpts describe a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and playful Jester identity focused on connection and enjoyment. This is supplied positioning, not proof of audience response.
Favor humorous, informal, creative and personable language; keep it useful and clear, and avoid unsupported product promises.

As advisory inspiration, consider the whole domestic space—architecture, circulation, colour relationships, daylight, furniture grouping and lived-in activity. Expressive, patterned rooms and quieter alternatives are both represented; no single room formula is required.
The official site currently presents a broad home-comfort range and uses the lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark with orange accents. This is an observation, not a mandatory campaign template.

visualRules.value: Use the supplied brand orange #F15A22 as a specified brand colour.
Use the supplied charcoal #414042 as a specified brand colour.

Preserve authentic logo artwork, proportions and clear space; do not rotate, distort, recolour, bevel, emboss or add a drop shadow. Prefer the master mark for general communication and use an appropriate authentic variant.
The supplied excerpts specify Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. Exact font rendering is subject to availability and verification.
Keep selected playful colours, patterns and mixed styles tied together by a coherent palette or design theme; the supplied excerpts also call for asymmetry.

preserve: Sleepyhead identity and authentic logo; do not substitute another brand’s identity.
Treat supplied guideline excerpts as partial guidance; their original version and approval status are not established.
Keep product appearance and product claims tied to exact official product evidence when a SKU is selected.
explore: Propose whole-room settings that express playful personality through considered colour, pattern, architecture and lived-in use.
Explore both expressive and quieter domestic treatments; Pinterest references are inspiration, not exact product or asset permission.
avoid: Do not use the conflicting #231F20 value as white or silently resolve the source discrepancy.
Do not copy third-party logos, products, claims, artwork or slogans from reference images.
Avoid unsupported efficacy promises and presenting advisory spatial references as mandatory Sleepyhead rules.
unknowns: The supplied guideline excerpts’ original version and approval status are unconfirmed.
White’s correct hex value remains unresolved; the supplied RGB supports #FFFFFF but the printed hex conflicts.
Production logo artwork and Migrena Grotesque files/licensing are not supplied; Source Sans Pro files are retained but not installed by upload.
No campaign, selected SKU, offer, audience or product claim has been specified.
guide.decisionSummary: Use the supplied Sleepyhead excerpts as scoped guidance, not a replacement brandbook. Preserve explicit identity rules and their source conflicts; treat website patterns as observations and spatial-board material as advisory inspiration. No campaign or product-specific decisions are approved.
